# IRS.gov - Internal Revenue Service

> > Official U.S. government portal for federal tax services, including tax payments, refunds, Free File, Employer Identification Numbers (EIN), Identity Protection PINs, and taxpayer assistance.

The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) provides comprehensive tax services for individuals, businesses, and tax professionals. The site offers multilingual support, digital tools like the Document Upload Tool, and resources for tax filing, refund tracking, and identity protection.

## Key Topics

- Internal Revenue Service (IRS)
- Tax payments and refunds
- IRS Free File
- Employer Identification Number (EIN)
- Identity Protection PIN
- Tax forms and filing
- Refund status tracking
- Taxpayer Assistance Center
- IRS Document Upload Tool
- Tax withholding
- Working Families Tax Cuts
- Taxpayer tools and services
- Tax compliance
- Federal tax obligations
- Multilingual tax assistance

## Main Portal

- [IRS Homepage](https://www.irs.gov): IRS main homepage: tax payments, refunds, Free File, and taxpayer tools

## Multilingual Tax Services

- [Spanish (Español)](https://www.irs.gov/es): IRS Spanish homepage with Free File, refund status, and tax assistance
- [Korean (한국어)](https://www.irs.gov/ko): IRS Korean homepage for tax payments, refunds, forms, and compliance help
- [Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt)](https://www.irs.gov/vi): IRS Vietnamese homepage for tax services, refunds, and EIN applications
- [Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)](https://www.irs.gov/zh-hant): IRS Traditional Chinese homepage for tax payments and federal obligations
- [Simplified Chinese (简体中文)](https://www.irs.gov/zh-hans): IRS Simplified Chinese homepage for tax services and EIN applications
- [Russian (Русский)](https://www.irs.gov/ru): IRS Russian homepage for tax payments, refunds, forms, and EIN services
- [Haitian Creole (Kreyòl Ayisyen)](https://www.irs.gov/ht): IRS Haitian Creole homepage for tax payments, refunds, and EIN services
